item.title: Gold price surges past $5,600 amid dollar weakness and geopolitical risk
item.description: Gold crossing the $5,600 per ounce threshold marks a turning point in global finance. It signals the weight of accumulated risks, deepening uncertainty, and intensifying political turbulence across the world economy. What once seemed like extraordinary price levels are now becoming the new normal, and leading financial institutions argue that this rally is only at its dawn. item.title: AWF, NOC collaborate to boost Azerbaijan’s Olympic wrestling prospects
item.description: A meeting has been held between the Azerbaijan Wrestling Federation (AWF) and officials of the National Olympic Committee (NOC) to discuss key ongoing initiatives and future projects, Azernews reports.

item.title: Ankara, Paris pledge to strengthen bilateral ties in high-level talks
item.description: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan held a joint press conference with France’s Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs, Jean-Noël Barrot, following their official talks.

item.title: Azerbaijan car loan interest rates rise to 13% in 2025
item.description: By the end of 2025, the average interest rate on car loans in Azerbaijan reached 13%, Azernews reports, citing the Central Bank of Azerbaijan. This represents a 3-percentage-point increase compared to the same period in 2024.

item.title: National Carpet Museum to present group exhibition
item.description: The Azerbaijan National Carpet Museum will host a group exhibition titled "Aether" starting January 30, Azernews reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan sees 27% growth in fruit and vegetable exports
item.description: In 2025, Azerbaijan exported 845,992 tons of fruits and vegetables, generating $901.5 million in revenue, Azernews reports, citing the State Customs Committee.

item.title: Russia, Ukraine reach preliminary agreement to halt strikes on energy infrastructure
item.description: Media reports say Russia and Ukraine have reached a preliminary agreement to ban strikes on energy infrastructure, marking a potential pause in one of the war’s most damaging fronts. According to Russian media, starting today, military personnel from both sides would be prohibited from attacking energy facilities, a step toward limiting destruction to civilian power grids and other critical systems, Azernews reports.

item.title: Rustam Behrudi's poetry book presented in Baku
item.description: The Baku Book Center hosted the presentation of a new book by renowned Azerbaijani poet Rustam Behrudi titled "Sənin gözlədiyin qərib türk mənəm", Azernews reports.

item.title: Azerbaijan accounts for 23% of Eurasia’s outbound investments to Asia, EDB says
item.description: Azerbaijan is among the key countries exporting capital from the Eurasian region, according to a new report by the Eurasian Development Bank (EDB), Azernews reports.

item.title: Pashinyan proposes linking Armenia’s energy system with Azerbaijan and Türkiye
item.description: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan said on January 29 that he considers it advisable to connect Armenia’s energy system with the energy networks of Azerbaijan and Türkiye, describing the initiative as both economically and strategically beneficial, Azernews reports.
